scope: Overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed) in the Ontario driver's handbook.

vocabulary.definition: The person operating the vehicle whose action is specified.
A change of lanes to move past a slower vehicle.
The driver overtaking or preparing to overtake another vehicle.
An area beside the vehicle, usually toward the rear, that the driver cannot see in the mirrors.
A portion of roadway connecting sidewalks on opposite sides into a continuous path or designated by signs, lines or other markings for pedestrian crossing.
A designated pedestrian crossing on a road without traffic lights, identified by crossover signs and pavement markings and potentially equipped with flashing overhead yellow lights.
A centre lane designated for traffic from either direction to wait for and make left turns.
A high-speed multilane road with opposing traffic separated and ramps for entry and exit.
A chrome-yellow bus marked with the words “School Bus.”
A physical barrier, such as a raised, lowered, earth or paved strip, constructed to separate opposing traffic and not crossable by vehicles.
An island or other area set aside at a streetcar stop for passengers boarding or alighting.
An orange triangle with a red border indicating a vehicle travelling at 40 km/h or less.
A double-trailer vehicle identified by a rear placard and measuring up to 40 metres long.
A police, fire, ambulance or special public-utility vehicle, identifiable in emergency operation by its warning lights, siren or bell.
A longitudinal pavement line composed of dashes separated by gaps.

rules.title: Speed limit still applies
rules.when: overtaking another vehicle
rules.action: exceed the applicable speed limit
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking another vehicle, the PASSER MUST NOT exceed the applicable speed limit.
rules.penalty: Demerit points depend on the excess speed and the applicable limit.
rules.note: The handbook distinguishes a slower vehicle's speed from the road's speed limit; passing is not a speed-limit exception.

rules.title: Enough time and space for the whole pass
rules.when: considering a PASS
rules.action: begin the PASS
rules.unless: sure there is enough space and time to complete it without danger to anyone
rules.statement: WHEN considering a PASS, the PASSER MUST NOT begin the PASS, UNLESS sure there is enough space and time to complete it without danger to anyone.

vague_terms.explanation: no universal gap or duration given
depends on traffic, visibility and the manoeuvre

rules.note: If in doubt, do not pass.

rules.title: Avoid unnecessary passing manoeuvres
rules.when: following another vehicle
rules.action: make unnecessary lane changes or weave from lane to lane to get around it
rules.statement: WHEN following another vehicle, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT make unnecessary lane changes or weave from lane to lane to get around it.
rules.note: The handbook particularly cautions against this in heavy traffic or bad weather; waiting a few seconds is often safer.

rules.title: Signal the passing lane change
rules.when: preparing to change lanes to overtake
rules.action: give a visible signal in the direction of the lane change well before moving, using the left-turn signal for a move to the left or the corresponding hand signal if the signal lights are not working
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to change lanes to overtake, the PASSER MUST give a visible signal in the direction of the lane change well before moving, using the left-turn signal for a move to the left or the corresponding hand signal if the signal lights are not working.
rules.penalty: Two demerit points for failing to signal.

vague_terms.explanation: enough notice for others to react; no time specified

rules.note: Signalling is a command in the passing procedure and failing to signal is listed as an offence. The hand signal for left is the left arm straight out; for right it is the left arm bent upward.

rules.title: Check the gap, blind spot and adjacent traffic
rules.when: preparing to move into a passing lane
rules.action: check ahead and behind, use the mirrors to find a safe gap, look over the shoulder on the passing side for bicycles and other small vehicles, and after signalling check the BLIND SPOT and the gap again for traffic closing from behind or moving in from two lanes over
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to move into a passing lane, the PASSER MUST check ahead and behind, use the mirrors to find a safe gap, look over the shoulder on the passing side for bicycles and other small vehicles, and after signalling check the BLIND SPOT and the gap again for traffic closing from behind or moving in from two lanes over.

vague_terms.explanation: depends on spacing and relative speeds

rules.note: The passing instructions and lane-change diagram give the sequence; the road-test instructions explicitly repeat the blind-spot check after signalling.

rules.title: Enter the passing lane gradually
rules.when: moving out to pass
rules.action: steer gradually to the centre of the new lane, maintaining speed or increasing it gently rather than slowing down during the lane change
rules.statement: WHEN moving out to pass, the PASSER MUST steer gradually to the centre of the new lane, maintaining speed or increasing it gently rather than slowing down during the lane change.
rules.note: The road-test guidance also calls for matching the speed of traffic in the new lane.

rules.title: Yield rather than cut in
rules.when: changing lanes to overtake or to return after overtaking
rules.action: cut in front of another vehicle, including a bicycle, or take its right-of-way merely because a signal has been given
rules.statement: WHEN changing lanes to overtake or to return after overtaking, the PASSER MUST NOT cut in front of another vehicle, including a bicycle, or take its right-of-way merely because a signal has been given.
rules.note: The freeway chapter specifically calls it illegal for a slower vehicle to cut in front of a faster one.

rules.title: Cancel each completed lane-change signal
rules.when: a lane change out to pass or back from passing is complete
rules.action: turn off the lane-change signal as soon as the change is complete
rules.statement: WHEN a lane change out to pass or back from passing is complete, the PASSER MUST turn off the lane-change signal as soon as the change is complete.
rules.note: The last stage of the lane-change diagram says to make sure the signal is off.

rules.title: Check for users hidden beyond the vehicle
rules.when: about to pass a vehicle
rules.action: watch for bicycles and small vehicles hidden in front of it, vehicles turning left ahead, and vehicles or pedestrians entering from a side road or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN about to pass a vehicle, the PASSER MUST watch for bicycles and small vehicles hidden in front of it, vehicles turning left ahead, and vehicles or pedestrians entering from a side road or driveway.

rules.title: See the entire front before returning
rules.when: returning to the original lane after overtaking
rules.action: signal the return and wait until the entire front of the overtaken vehicle is visible in the inside rearview mirror before moving back
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after overtaking, the PASSER MUST signal the return and wait until the entire front of the overtaken vehicle is visible in the inside rearview mirror before moving back.
rules.penalty: Two demerit points for failing to signal.
rules.note: The same clearance test is given for passing at night.

rules.title: Abandon a pass instead of racing
rules.when: the vehicle being overtaken speeds up
rules.action: go back to the original lane rather than race the other vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being overtaken speeds up, the PASSER MUST go back to the original lane rather than race the other vehicle.

rules.title: Early signal in heavy traffic
rules.when: traffic in the intended passing lane is heavy
rules.action: signal the intended lane change before there is enough space to move, without entering until the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN traffic in the intended passing lane is heavy, the PASSER MAY signal the intended lane change before there is enough space to move, without entering until the way is clear.
rules.note: Normally the signal is given when a space is available; the early signal requests space, not priority.

rules.title: Spacing during a passing lane change
rules.when: changing lanes to pass with a vehicle ahead
rules.action: keep at least a two- to three-second distance behind the vehicle ahead and, if there is a lane beyond the target lane, take care not to move in beside another vehicle or into its BLIND SPOT
rules.statement: WHEN changing lanes to pass with a vehicle ahead, the PASSER MUST keep at least a two- to three-second distance behind the vehicle ahead and, if there is a lane beyond the target lane, take care not to move in beside another vehicle or into its BLIND SPOT.
rules.note: This is the lane-change guidance; the general two-second minimum is for ideal conditions only.

rules.title: Control the steering during a passing lane change
rules.when: changing lanes to pass
rules.action: keep both hands on the steering wheel
rules.unless: a disability prevents use of both hands
rules.statement: WHEN changing lanes to pass, the PASSER MUST keep both hands on the steering wheel, UNLESS a disability prevents use of both hands.
rules.note: The general steering chapter says “should” for most lane changes; the road-test procedure gives the stronger direction and an exception.

rules.title: Normally keep right
rules.when: driving along a road
rules.action: keep to the right of the road or in the right-hand lane on a multilane road
rules.unless: intending to turn left OR intending to pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving along a road, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right of the road or in the right-hand lane on a multilane road, UNLESS intending to turn left OR intending to pass another vehicle.
rules.note: Particularly important for traffic moving more slowly than other vehicles.

rules.title: Truck passing lane beside a restricted far-left lane
rules.when: a high-speed road has three or more lanes in each direction AND trucks are prohibited from the far-left lane
rules.action: use the lane immediately to its right for passing rather than the far-left lane
rules.statement: WHEN a high-speed road has three or more lanes in each direction AND trucks are prohibited from the far-left lane, the DRIVER of a large truck MUST use the lane immediately to its right for passing rather than the far-left lane.
rules.note: The handbook says the restriction applies on many such roads, not on all of them.

rules.title: Clear the truck passing lane
rules.when: occupying the lane next to a far-left lane prohibited to trucks AND a truck wants to pass
rules.action: move into the right-hand lane as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN occupying the lane next to a far-left lane prohibited to trucks AND a truck wants to pass, the DRIVER MUST move into the right-hand lane as soon as possible.

rules.title: Use climbing and passing lanes in the indicated order
rules.when: on a two-lane section signed to keep right except when passing
rules.action: use the right-hand lane so faster vehicles can pass on the left
rules.statement: WHEN on a two-lane section signed to keep right except when passing, the DRIVER MUST use the right-hand lane so faster vehicles can pass on the left, UNLESS passing.
rules.penalty: Two demerit points for failing to obey signs.
rules.note: The passing-lane chapter describes the arrangement; the regulatory sign directs its use.

rules.title: Merge at the end of the additional lane
rules.when: in the right-hand lane of a passing or climbing section AND a sign indicates that the right lane ends ahead
rules.action: merge safely with traffic in the lane to the left before the right lane ends
rules.statement: WHEN in the right-hand lane of a passing or climbing section AND a sign indicates that the right lane ends ahead, the DRIVER MUST merge safely with traffic in the lane to the left before the right lane ends.
rules.note: The lane-ending sign makes explicit the movement described in the passing-lane chapter.

rules.title: Leave freeway passing lanes clear
rules.when: driving on a multilane FREEWAY
rules.action: drive in the right-hand lane when possible, use the far-left lane to pass traffic moving slower than the speed limit, and leave it after passing
rules.unless: the vehicle is prohibited from using the far-left lane
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a multilane FREEWAY, the DRIVER MUST drive in the right-hand lane when possible, use the far-left lane to pass traffic moving slower than the speed limit, and leave it after passing, UNLESS the vehicle is prohibited from using the far-left lane.

vague_terms.explanation: depends on lane availability and traffic

rules.note: The exception concerns use of the far-left lane, not the instruction to keep right. The earlier freeway passage says “should”; the later one directs drivers not to stay in the passing lane.

rules.title: Slower traffic keep right sign
rules.when: travelling more slowly than other traffic on a multilane road signed for slower traffic to keep right
rules.action: keep right
rules.statement: WHEN travelling more slowly than other traffic on a multilane road signed for slower traffic to keep right, the DRIVER MUST keep right.
rules.penalty: Two demerit points for failing to obey signs.

rules.title: Vehicle stopped at a crosswalk
rules.when: another vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK
rules.action: pass the stopped vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK, the PASSER MUST NOT pass the stopped vehicle.
rules.note: An unmarked crosswalk is still a crosswalk; the stopped vehicle may hide a pedestrian.

rules.title: Thirty metres from a pedestrian crossover
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: pass any vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the PASSER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.
rules.note: This restriction does not depend on a vehicle already being stopped or the overhead lights flashing.

rules.title: No passing in the two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: a centre lane is designated as a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: use that lane to pass
rules.statement: WHEN a centre lane is designated as a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE, the PASSER MUST NOT use that lane to pass.
rules.note: The regulatory lane designation allows only two-way left turns.

rules.title: No passing lane change at an intersection
rules.when: in or near an intersection
rules.action: change lanes to pass
rules.statement: WHEN in or near an intersection, the PASSER MUST NOT change lanes to pass.
rules.note: If a left-turning vehicle or a vehicle edging in from the right blocks the lane in the intersection, slow down or stop instead of pulling out around it.

rules.title: Bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.when: within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.action: pass to the left of the centre line
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, the PASSER MUST NOT pass to the left of the centre line.
rules.note: The prohibition specifies the side of the centre line; it does not prohibit all same-direction multilane passing.

rules.title: Obstructed sight distance at a crest or curve
rules.when: approaching the crest of a hill or travelling on a curve where the view of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety
rules.action: attempt a PASS
rules.statement: WHEN approaching the crest of a hill or travelling on a curve where the view of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety, the PASSER MUST NOT attempt a PASS.

vague_terms.term: enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety
vague_terms.explanation: depends on sight line, speeds and length of pass

rules.title: No passing sign
rules.when: a regulatory sign showing a barred passing manoeuvre applies to the road
rules.action: pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a regulatory sign showing a barred passing manoeuvre applies to the road, the PASSER MUST NOT pass another vehicle.
rules.penalty: Two demerit points for failing to obey signs.

rules.title: Signed no-passing approach to a crossover
rules.when: between a no-passing-here-to-crossing sign and the PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER it marks
rules.action: pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN between a no-passing-here-to-crossing sign and the PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER it marks, the PASSER MUST NOT pass another vehicle.
rules.penalty: Two demerit points for failing to obey signs.
rules.note: The sign image reads “NO PASSING HERE TO CROSSING”; the caption identifies the crossover.

rules.title: Solid line on the passing side
rules.when: there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the vehicle's lane
rules.action: pass across that line
rules.statement: WHEN there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the vehicle's lane, the PASSER SHOULD NOT pass across that line.
rules.note: The handbook says it is unsafe and that the vehicle should not pass; it does not word this as the regulatory no-passing-sign prohibition.

rules.title: Broken line on the passing side
rules.when: there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the vehicle's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS safely
rules.action: pass across that line
rules.statement: WHEN there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the vehicle's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS safely, the PASSER MAY pass across that line.

vague_terms.explanation: no traffic gap or sight distance given

rules.note: Use the marking on the driver's own side, including when the line on the opposing side is solid.

rules.title: Right shoulder only for a left-turning vehicle
rules.when: the vehicle ahead is turning left AND the right shoulder is paved
rules.action: use the right shoulder to pass that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle ahead is turning left AND the right shoulder is paved, the PASSER MAY ONLY use the right shoulder to pass that vehicle.
rules.note: Both conditions are necessary to use the right shoulder for passing; using it is not compulsory.

rules.title: Left shoulder never a passing route
rules.when: overtaking another vehicle
rules.action: pass on the left shoulder, whether paved or unpaved
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking another vehicle, the PASSER MUST NOT pass on the left shoulder, whether paved or unpaved.

rules.title: Situations allowing a pass on the right
rules.when: on a multilane road OR on a one-way road OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN on a multilane road OR on a one-way road OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle, the PASSER MAY pass on the right.
rules.note: Most passing is on the left. Permission to pass on the right does not by itself permit using a shoulder or passing boarding streetcar passengers.

rules.title: Slower vehicle in the leftmost lane
rules.when: in the leftmost lane behind a slower vehicle
rules.action: wait for it to move right rather than suddenly changing lanes to pass it on the right
rules.statement: WHEN in the leftmost lane behind a slower vehicle, the PASSER MUST wait for it to move right rather than suddenly changing lanes to pass it on the right.
rules.note: The driver ahead may move right at the same time.

rules.title: Use the lane to discourage an unsafe pass
rules.actor: DRIVER of a bicycle or moped
rules.when: travelling more slowly than other traffic AND the lane is too narrow to be shared safely
rules.action: use any part of the lane to discourage passing
rules.statement: WHEN travelling more slowly than other traffic AND the lane is too narrow to be shared safely, the DRIVER of a bicycle or moped MAY use any part of the lane to discourage passing.

vague_terms.term: too narrow to be shared safely

rules.note: This is an exception to the expected position about one metre from a curb or parked cars, or as close as practical to the right edge without a curb.

rules.title: One metre when passing a cyclist
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: keep at least one metre between the motor vehicle and the CYCLIST where practical
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST keep at least one metre between the motor vehicle and the CYCLIST where practical.
rules.penalty: Possible fine and two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: does not specify when one metre is impractical

rules.title: Change lanes to pass a smaller vehicle
rules.when: passing a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: change lanes to pass rather than treat the rider's movement to one side as an invitation to pass in the same lane
rules.statement: WHEN passing a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the PASSER MUST change lanes to pass rather than treat the rider's movement to one side as an invitation to pass in the same lane.
rules.note: The cyclist section advises changing lanes whenever possible; the passing section gives the stronger instruction. Motorcycles use a full lane.

rules.title: Horn when overtaking a cyclist
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST
rules.action: sound the horn
rules.unless: it is necessary to use it
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST, the PASSER MUST NOT sound the horn, UNLESS it is necessary to use it.

vague_terms.explanation: no specific trigger for sounding the horn

rules.note: A horn can startle the rider and cause loss of control.

rules.title: How to warn a cyclist if a horn is needed
rules.when: a horn warning is necessary while overtaking a CYCLIST
rules.action: tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance away
rules.statement: WHEN a horn warning is necessary while overtaking a CYCLIST, the PASSER MUST tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance away.

rules.title: Wait behind a smaller vehicle turning left
rules.when: turning left behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped that is also turning left
rules.action: stay behind rather than pull alongside to turn together, turn when the way is clear, and wait for the smaller vehicle to move right before passing
rules.statement: WHEN turning left behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped that is also turning left, the PASSER MUST stay behind rather than pull alongside to turn together, turn when the way is clear, and wait for the smaller vehicle to move right before passing.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance specified

rules.title: Leave stopping room in front of a large vehicle
rules.when: passing a large commercial vehicle
rules.action: allow more room before moving back in front and leave the space it needs to stop safely
rules.statement: WHEN passing a large commercial vehicle, the PASSER MUST allow more room before moving back in front and leave the space it needs to stop safely.

vague_terms.term: space it needs to stop safely
vague_terms.explanation: depends on the vehicle, speed and conditions

rules.note: The diagram compares stopping distances at the same speed; it does not prescribe a fixed cut-in distance.

rules.title: Do not move up inside a large vehicle's right turn
rules.when: a large vehicle ahead swings out to make a right turn
rules.action: stay well back until it has completely cleared the lane rather than move up into the space that opens on its right
rules.statement: WHEN a large vehicle ahead swings out to make a right turn, the DRIVER MUST stay well back until it has completely cleared the lane rather than move up into the space that opens on its right.

rules.title: Do not move up inside a truck's off-ramp left turn
rules.when: on an expressway off-ramp with two left-turn lanes AND a large vehicle ahead is turning left
rules.action: stay well back until it has cleared the turn instead of driving up into the lane on its left
rules.statement: WHEN on an expressway off-ramp with two left-turn lanes AND a large vehicle ahead is turning left, the DRIVER MUST stay well back until it has cleared the turn instead of driving up into the lane on its left.

rules.title: Passing a vehicle with the slow-moving sign
rules.when: approaching a vehicle displaying a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN from behind
rules.action: slow down, stay well back and wait until it is safe to pass
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a vehicle displaying a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN from behind, the PASSER MUST slow down, stay well back and wait until it is safe to pass.

vague_terms.explanation: requires a judgement of traffic and visibility

rules.note: Farm machinery may be wide or long and may turn directly into a field.

rules.title: Passing a horse-drawn vehicle
rules.when: approaching a horse-drawn vehicle from behind
rules.action: slow down, maintain a safe following distance, wait until it is safe to pass and give as much distance as possible alongside the horse-drawn vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a horse-drawn vehicle from behind, the PASSER MUST slow down, maintain a safe following distance, wait until it is safe to pass and give as much distance as possible alongside the horse-drawn vehicle.
rules.note: Passing closely may startle the horse. The instruction applies on seeing the horse-drawn vehicle, not just its rear sign.

rules.title: Watch for opening doors on parked vehicles
rules.when: passing parked vehicles
rules.action: watch for people about to pull out or open doors and for doors already open for loading or unloading
rules.statement: WHEN passing parked vehicles, the PASSER MUST watch for people about to pull out or open doors and for doors already open for loading or unloading.

rules.title: Account for a marked double trailer
rules.when: preparing to pass a LONG COMMERCIAL VEHICLE on a highway
rules.action: recognize its rear placard and account for its extended length and limited speed in planning the pass
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to pass a LONG COMMERCIAL VEHICLE on a highway, the PASSER MUST recognize its rear placard and account for its extended length and limited speed in planning the pass.
rules.note: The placard identifies a double trailer, not the exact length of that particular vehicle.

rules.title: Passing a streetcar passenger island or zone
rules.when: passing a STREETCAR SAFETY ZONE
rules.action: pass at a reasonable speed and be ready for pedestrians to move suddenly or unexpectedly
rules.statement: WHEN passing a STREETCAR SAFETY ZONE, the PASSER MUST pass at a reasonable speed and be ready for pedestrians to move suddenly or unexpectedly.
rules.note: This is the procedure for a stop with an area set aside for passengers, rather than the two-metre rear-door rule.

rules.title: School bus preparing to stop
rules.when: approaching a SCHOOL BUS from behind or from the front AND its overhead amber lights are flashing
rules.action: slow down and prepare to stop
rules.unless: approaching from the front on a road with a MEDIAN STRIP
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a SCHOOL BUS from behind or from the front AND its overhead amber lights are flashing, the DRIVER MUST slow down and prepare to stop, UNLESS approaching from the front on a road with a MEDIAN STRIP.
rules.note: Amber warns of an impending passenger stop; it is distinct from the red-light or stop-arm command.

rules.title: Do not overtake a school bus displaying its stop signal
rules.when: approaching from behind a SCHOOL BUS displaying flashing overhead red lights or an activated stop arm
rules.action: stop at least 20 metres behind the bus rather than pass it
rules.statement: WHEN approaching from behind a SCHOOL BUS displaying flashing overhead red lights or an activated stop arm, the DRIVER MUST stop at least 20 metres behind the bus rather than pass it.
rules.penalty: A heavy fine and six demerit points for a first offence.
rules.note: Applies with or without a median, on any road, regardless of lane count, speed limit or school hours. A registered owner may receive the fine, but not points or jail time, for a reported violation.

rules.title: Opposing traffic must not pass a signalling school bus on an undivided road
rules.when: approaching from the front a SCHOOL BUS displaying flashing overhead red lights or an activated stop arm
rules.action: stop at a safe distance for children to leave the bus and cross in front of the vehicle
rules.unless: the road has a MEDIAN STRIP
rules.statement: WHEN approaching from the front a SCHOOL BUS displaying flashing overhead red lights or an activated stop arm, the DRIVER MUST stop at a safe distance for children to leave the bus and cross in front of the vehicle, UNLESS the road has a MEDIAN STRIP.
rules.penalty: A heavy fine and six demerit points for a first offence.

vague_terms.explanation: no numerical distance for opposing traffic

rules.note: Multiple lanes alone do not qualify as a median. The 20-metre minimum applies to traffic coming from behind.

rules.title: Wait for school bus stop signals to clear
rules.when: stopped for a SCHOOL BUS displaying its red lights or stop arm
rules.action: proceed
rules.unless: the bus moves AND the overhead red lights have stopped flashing AND the stop arm is no longer activated
rules.statement: WHEN stopped for a SCHOOL BUS displaying its red lights or stop arm, the DRIVER MUST NOT proceed, UNLESS the bus moves AND the overhead red lights have stopped flashing AND the stop arm is no longer activated.
rules.note: 6.89 gives all three conditions. 8.26 says the bus moves or its lights stop flashing; 8.31 directs drivers to remain stopped until the arm folds away and all lights stop flashing. The stricter wording is retained.

rules.title: Side for passing a streetcar
rules.when: passing a streetcar
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN passing a streetcar, the PASSER MUST pass on the right, UNLESS driving on a one-way road.
rules.note: 10.40 permits passing a streetcar on the right; 10.44 makes that side mandatory except on a one-way road.

rules.title: Stay behind a streetcar boarding or discharging passengers
rules.when: approaching a stopped streetcar where passengers are getting on or off
rules.action: stay at least two metres behind its rear doors
rules.unless: there is a STREETCAR SAFETY ZONE at the stop
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stopped streetcar where passengers are getting on or off, the PASSER MUST stay at least two metres behind its rear doors, UNLESS there is a STREETCAR SAFETY ZONE at the stop.
rules.note: Measure from the rear doors, not from the rear bumper.

rules.title: Check for a passing cyclist before opening a door
rules.when: parked beside the roadway and about to open a door next to passing traffic
rules.action: look behind, check the mirrors and BLIND SPOT for a passing CYCLIST, and open the door only when it will not endanger anyone or interfere with traffic
rules.statement: WHEN parked beside the roadway and about to open a door next to passing traffic, the DRIVER MUST look behind, check the mirrors and BLIND SPOT for a passing CYCLIST, and open the door only when it will not endanger anyone or interfere with traffic.
rules.penalty: Three demerit points for improper opening of a vehicle door.
rules.note: The prescribed checks are instructions; improper opening is listed as an offence.

rules.title: Do not accelerate or obstruct the pass
rules.when: another driver is trying to pass
rules.action: speed up or drive so as to prevent the other vehicle from passing
rules.statement: WHEN another driver is trying to pass, the DRIVER MUST NOT speed up or drive so as to prevent the other vehicle from passing.
rules.note: Speeding up while being passed is expressly called unlawful; preventing another vehicle from passing is also listed as aggressive driving.

rules.title: Move right for an overtaking vehicle
rules.when: faster traffic is about to overtake
rules.action: move to the right and let it pass in safety
rules.statement: WHEN faster traffic is about to overtake, the DRIVER MUST move to the right and let it pass in safety.

vague_terms.explanation: depends on roadway space and traffic

rules.note: 10.25 gives the instruction; the keyed knowledge-test question asks what the driver must do.

rules.title: Being passed in the opposing lane
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road AND the PASSER has entered the opposing lane
rules.action: watch oncoming traffic, move closer to the right side of the lane, and be prepared to slow down to let the PASSER get in front more quickly to prevent a collision
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road AND the PASSER has entered the opposing lane, the DRIVER MUST watch oncoming traffic, move closer to the right side of the lane, and be prepared to slow down to let the PASSER get in front more quickly to prevent a collision.
rules.note: This calls for readiness to slow; it does not require braking every time someone passes.

rules.title: Make room for an emergency vehicle to pass
rules.when: an EMERGENCY VEHICLE approaches from behind with flashing red or red and blue lights or a sounding siren or bell
rules.action: clear the way and stop immediately as near as practical to the right-hand curb or road edge, or at the closest curb or edge on a one-way road or divided highway having more than two lanes, keeping shoulders, intersections and ramps clear until it passes
rules.statement: WHEN an EMERGENCY VEHICLE approaches from behind with flashing red or red and blue lights or a sounding siren or bell, the DRIVER MUST clear the way and stop immediately as near as practical to the right-hand curb or road edge, or at the closest curb or edge on a one-way road or divided highway having more than two lanes, keeping shoulders, intersections and ramps clear until it passes.
rules.penalty: Possible fine and three demerit points for a first offence; increased fines and possible jail up to six months for additional offences.
rules.note: This is the overtaking case of a rule applying to approaches from any direction. Signal, check surrounding traffic and brake gradually, not abruptly. In a roundabout, take the intended exit and clear the traffic island before pulling over.

rules.title: Do not turn across an emergency vehicle's passing path
rules.when: in an intersection preparing to turn AND an EMERGENCY VEHICLE is approaching
rules.action: abandon the turn, clear the intersection straight ahead when safe, then pull right and stop
rules.statement: WHEN in an intersection preparing to turn AND an EMERGENCY VEHICLE is approaching, the DRIVER SHOULD abandon the turn, clear the intersection straight ahead when safe, then pull right and stop.
rules.note: The emergency vehicle may pass on the side toward which the driver intended to turn.

rules.title: Rejoin only after the emergency vehicle passes
rules.when: an EMERGENCY VEHICLE has passed after the DRIVER pulled over for it
rules.action: watch for additional emergency vehicles, check that the way is clear and signal before merging back into traffic
rules.statement: WHEN an EMERGENCY VEHICLE has passed after the DRIVER pulled over for it, the DRIVER MUST watch for additional emergency vehicles, check that the way is clear and signal before merging back into traffic.

rules.title: Leave pull-out room when stopped behind a vehicle
rules.when: stopped behind another vehicle at an intersection
rules.action: leave enough space to pull out and pass it without backing up
rules.statement: WHEN stopped behind another vehicle at an intersection, the DRIVER MUST leave enough space to pull out and pass it without backing up.

vague_terms.explanation: depends on vehicle position and turning clearance

rules.note: This reserves manoeuvring room if the vehicle stalls; it does not authorize a pass through an occupied intersection.

rules.title: Check for an overtaker before turning
rules.when: another vehicle could overtake while the DRIVER is turning
rules.action: check the BLIND SPOT before starting the turn
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle could overtake while the DRIVER is turning, the DRIVER MUST check the BLIND SPOT before starting the turn.
rules.note: For a right turn the handbook specifically calls for checking the mirrors and right blind spot for a cyclist.

rules.title: Check for an overtaker before a roadside stop
rules.when: pulling over for a roadside stop AND traffic or pedestrians may be overtaking on the right
rules.action: check the right BLIND SPOT just before pulling over
rules.statement: WHEN pulling over for a roadside stop AND traffic or pedestrians may be overtaking on the right, the DRIVER MUST check the right BLIND SPOT just before pulling over.

rules.title: Low beams behind another vehicle
rules.when: using headlights less than 60 metres behind another vehicle
rules.action: use low beams, including on a divided road
rules.statement: WHEN using headlights less than 60 metres behind another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST use low beams, including on a divided road, UNLESS passing that vehicle.
rules.penalty: Two demerit points for failing to lower the headlight beam.
rules.note: 4.65 explicitly gives the passing exception. 14.8 describes the following distance as “within 60 metres.” The night-passing procedure specifies when to switch beams.

rules.title: Night pass: low on approach, high alongside if permitted
rules.when: it is necessary to pass at night AND the way is clear
rules.action: switch to low beams on approaching from behind, signal and check the mirrors and BLIND SPOT before pulling out, and switch to high beams only on drawing alongside if conditions permit high beams
rules.statement: WHEN it is necessary to pass at night AND the way is clear, the PASSER MUST switch to low beams on approaching from behind, signal and check the mirrors and BLIND SPOT before pulling out, and switch to high beams only on drawing alongside if conditions permit high beams.

vague_terms.explanation: handbook does not specify when a night pass is needed
no safe gap or sight distance given

rules.note: The alongside step does not override the low-beam rule within 150 metres of an oncoming vehicle on any road, or low-beam instructions for fog or blowing snow. Signal and use the whole-front-in-mirror test before returning right.

rules.title: No passing lane change in a construction zone
rules.when: driving through a construction zone
rules.action: change lanes to pass
rules.statement: WHEN driving through a construction zone, the PASSER MUST NOT change lanes to pass.
rules.note: The handbook instructs drivers not to change lanes in the zone and to obey the people, signs and devices directing traffic there.

rules.title: Passing roadside work and assistance vehicles
rules.when: passing roadside assistance or disabled vehicles, surveyors, maintenance workers or utility workers on the road
rules.action: slow down, pass with caution and move over a lane if safe to do so to increase clearance
rules.statement: WHEN passing roadside assistance or disabled vehicles, surveyors, maintenance workers or utility workers on the road, the PASSER MUST slow down, pass with caution and move over a lane if safe to do so to increase clearance.

vague_terms.explanation: depends on available lanes and gaps

rules.title: Slow to pass a stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck
rules.when: approaching in the same direction a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE flashing red or red and blue lights, or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights
rules.action: assess the speed of surrounding traffic and the road conditions, reduce speed and proceed with caution
rules.statement: WHEN approaching in the same direction a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE flashing red or red and blue lights, or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights, the PASSER MUST assess the speed of surrounding traffic and the road conditions, reduce speed and proceed with caution.
rules.penalty: Possible fine and three demerit points for a first offence; increased fines and possible jail up to six months for additional offences.

vague_terms.explanation: depends on conditions and other traffic

rules.note: Slowing down is required even if moving over is impossible.

rules.title: Brake progressively for the roadside pass
rules.when: slowing to pass a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE flashing red or red and blue lights, or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights, in the same direction
rules.action: brake early and gradually and watch for fast-approaching traffic behind
rules.statement: WHEN slowing to pass a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE flashing red or red and blue lights, or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights, in the same direction, the PASSER MUST brake early and gradually and watch for fast-approaching traffic behind.

vague_terms.explanation: no braking distance or rate specified

rules.title: Prefer brakes to downshifting for the roadside pass
rules.when: slowing to pass a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE flashing red or red and blue lights, or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights, in the same direction
rules.action: use the brakes rather than downshifting so the rear brake lights indicate the reduction in speed
rules.statement: WHEN slowing to pass a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE flashing red or red and blue lights, or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights, in the same direction, the PASSER in a manual-transmission vehicle SHOULD use the brakes rather than downshifting so the rear brake lights indicate the reduction in speed.

rules.title: Move away one lane as well as slowing
rules.when: approaching in the same direction a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE flashing red or red and blue lights, or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights AND there are two or more lanes in the direction of travel
rules.action: move into a lane away from the stopped vehicle well in advance, in addition to slowing down and proceeding with caution
rules.unless: it is not safe to move over
rules.statement: WHEN approaching in the same direction a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE flashing red or red and blue lights, or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights AND there are two or more lanes in the direction of travel, the PASSER MUST move into a lane away from the stopped vehicle well in advance, in addition to slowing down and proceeding with caution, UNLESS it is not safe to move over.
rules.penalty: Possible fine and three demerit points for a first offence; increased fines and possible jail up to six months for additional offences.

vague_terms.explanation: depends on lane availability and other traffic

rules.note: Before moving over, check ahead, both sides and mirrors, signal, then recheck mirrors and shoulder-check blind spots. The safety exception applies only to moving over.

rules.title: No passing a signed pilot or pace vehicle
rules.when: a pilot or pace vehicle bears the temporary no-passing-when-flashing sign AND the signal is flashing
rules.action: pass the pilot or pace vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a pilot or pace vehicle bears the temporary no-passing-when-flashing sign AND the signal is flashing, the PASSER MUST NOT pass the pilot or pace vehicle.
rules.note: The caption identifies the vehicle; the illustrated sign supplies the qualifier “WHEN FLASHING.”

rules.title: Do not pass moving snow plows
rules.when: a snow plow ahead is moving
rules.action: pass the snow plow
rules.statement: WHEN a snow plow ahead is moving, the PASSER MUST NOT pass the snow plow.
rules.note: 10.15 says “under any conditions.” Snow-removal vehicles use flashing blue lights and may have a wing extending up to three metres to the right.

rules.title: Do not pass in fog
rules.when: driving in fog
rules.action: pass another vehicle or speed up to pass a slow-moving vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving in fog, the PASSER MUST NOT pass another vehicle or speed up to pass a slow-moving vehicle.
rules.note: 14.19 says to avoid passing; 14.31 prohibits speeding up to pass and 14.35 gives the stronger direction not to pass.

rules.title: Avoid passing in blowing snow or a whiteout
rules.when: driving in blowing snow or a whiteout
rules.action: pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving in blowing snow or a whiteout, the PASSER SHOULD NOT pass another vehicle.
rules.note: The general advice is to avoid passing; there is a separate direct instruction concerning slow vehicles.

rules.title: No attempt to pass a slow vehicle in blowing snow
rules.when: driving in blowing snow or a whiteout AND the vehicle ahead is moving slowly
rules.action: attempt to pass it
rules.statement: WHEN driving in blowing snow or a whiteout AND the vehicle ahead is moving slowly, the PASSER MUST NOT attempt to pass it.

rules.title: Do not pass between staggered plows
rules.when: snow plows are staggered across a FREEWAY clearing lanes together
rules.action: try to pass between them
rules.statement: WHEN snow plows are staggered across a FREEWAY clearing lanes together, the PASSER MUST NOT try to pass between them.
rules.note: The apparent gap can contain a ridge of wet snow being passed from plow to plow.

rules.title: Keep a trailer out of the fast lanes
rules.when: towing a trailer
rules.action: keep out of the fast lanes and maintain spacing and speed that allow smooth slowing and stopping
rules.statement: WHEN towing a trailer, the DRIVER MUST keep out of the fast lanes and maintain spacing and speed that allow smooth slowing and stopping.

rules.title: Allow time and clearance for the whole trailer
rules.when: towing a trailer and overtaking
rules.action: make sure there is enough time and room for the slower acceleration and greater length before starting, and allow more room after passing before returning to the original lane
rules.statement: WHEN towing a trailer and overtaking, the PASSER MUST make sure there is enough time and room for the slower acceleration and greater length before starting, and allow more room after passing before returning to the original lane.

vague_terms.explanation: depends on combination length, acceleration and traffic

rules.note: Cutting back too soon can make the trailer sway.

rules.title: Let a queue pass the trailer
rules.when: towing a trailer AND holding up a line of traffic
rules.action: signal, pull over and let the other vehicles pass
rules.statement: WHEN towing a trailer AND holding up a line of traffic, the DRIVER MUST signal, pull over and let the other vehicles pass.

rules.title: Recover from a passing truck's air disturbance
rules.when: towing a trailer AND air displaced by a passing large bus or truck pushes the trailer sideways
rules.action: steer the vehicle and trailer carefully back into position without braking
rules.statement: WHEN towing a trailer AND air displaced by a passing large bus or truck pushes the trailer sideways, the DRIVER MUST steer the vehicle and trailer carefully back into position without braking.
rules.note: The handbook says a slight increase in speed may help; it does not require accelerating.
